text: BAM share rose 0.23 percentage points over the last 22 hours and 0.29 percentage points over 7 days, now at 34.3% of Solana stake. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee leads with 22.1% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The latest leadership change was whale-driven routing from ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee to ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee, not a structural rollover.
